$meta.readThisFirst: 2.0.0 REPLACES the 62px geometry that shipped in field-type-1 1.x. That file was marked superseded on 2026-09-10 but never carried the corrected numbers, so the repo's only machine-readable primary-field height stayed WRONG (62) while the live component was 66. Build from the geometry below.

purpose: Complete VIEW-mode field: data grids, tables, list views. Read-first — the value row has no input border of its own; the state colour lives on the container.

variantAxis.name: state
variantAxis.note: Figma's generated docs for this set claim 6 variants and omit state=ai. The 7 are measured from the set's symbol children — trust the nodes, not the prose.

size.supersedes: 62 (measured 2026-08-24, before Figma grew the header row 26 → 30)

geometry.widthRule: 360 is the variant's own width; treat as 100% of parent. pattern-page-form-grid instances it at 254.5px.

states.figmaSideDefect: the master's sample value text reads "Warning input value" — a copy-paste slip in Figma (confirmed live by Antigravity on node 27079:10668). Cosmetic, Figma-side.

states.resolvedDefect: 1.x recorded 'disabled emits NO background'. Figma now binds field/bg-disabled — the defect is RESOLVED, do not carry the old warning forward.

contradictsFigmaProse.resolution: The bound variables win. Figma's prose is stale.

header.resolvedDefect: 1.x recorded 'required marker and help icon are OFF in all 7 variants — a hard blocker for clinical forms'. Figma replaced the hand-built header with the real field-header-primary component, which carries required / help / error / AI icon slots. RESOLVED.

behavior: Display-mode field. In product flows, entering edit switches the context to form-field-secondary. The ai state marks auto-populated values and pairs with the header's AI icon and an AI field-message. No hover state exists on the axis — building one would be an invention.
defects: no message row of its own — the error state is fill + border only, with nowhere to put the message. Use form-field-secondary when a message must show.
no hover state on the axis
state=ai sample copy reads 'Warning input value' (Figma-side copy slip)

accessibility.labelAssociation: the label is a real row — use <label for> or aria-labelledby
accessibility.errorState: aria-invalid + aria-describedby, BUT this component has no message row to point at (see defects) — point at a sibling, or use form-field-secondary
accessibility.required: aria-required + the header's required marker (now available)
accessibility.disabled: disabled + aria-disabled. readonly is INERT on <select> — emit disabled there

focusRing.note: only a border-colour + background change is specified; whether an additional ring is intended is unknown

implementationRisk.issue: A Material mat-form-field appearance="outline" CANNOT produce this layout.
implementationRisk.why: Material renders the label as a floating notch that INTERRUPTS the top border. This component renders it as a static full-width row stacked ABOVE the value, inside an UNBROKEN border. Different structures, not different skins.
implementationRisk.consequence: No amount of token overriding converts one into the other.
implementationRisk.decisionRequired: Either build a custom control, or redraw the design to match Material. Decide BEFORE producing an implementation diff.

notVerified: dark / high-contrast / warm-dark / hc-light values (light mode only)
focus ring in addition to the border-colour change
read-only vs disabled as distinct states
icon SVG path data (box sizes and fill tokens verified; path geometry is not archived)
the 12 variants of Global/Atom/Fields Toys (trailing controls)
